CVE-2026-57848 (ShareTargetActivity accepts app-private content URIs, fix 50d5f514) is valid but was left out to keep the total at 24.
CVE-2021-0341 (OkHostnameVerifier) is in a general JVM HTTP library rather than mobile app or mobile-specific code; left out.
PR 199 ('ECB to GCM'): the 'ECB' is the RSA block-mode label, and the fixed code sets setRandomizedEncryptionRequired(false). Not a clean crypto pair.
PR 549 (link previews default to https) is a functional change (http previews were already never loaded), not a security fix.
http-to-https changes (PR 2113, PR 56, PR 77) are ATS or consistency changes and do not state a security problem.
CVE-2026-103922 (navigation guard ignores proxy path) is in a hybrid runtime and is fixed across several Android/iOS files plus proxy serving logic; not a single-file mobile app pair.
Not used: very large monorepo (about 8 GB of history), already heavily represented in the earlier benchmark.
GHSL-2026-101/103 (deep link and WebView cookie theft) not used. The repository was marked as excluded in the earlier benchmark, so it was skipped to keep the holdout blind.
PR 7450 (sync settings behind Face ID, HackerOne) and PR 8456 (javascript: URLs from the omnibox) are logic/UI changes across several files; PR 7721 was used instead.
Issue 5588 (NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads for API domains): Info.plist-only, not source code. GHSL Signal-iOS advisories are authorization logic outside the target families.
PR 2 (fork of the Adjust SDK) removes unused MD5/SHA-1 helpers and changes keychain accessibility for a non-sensitive tracking UUID; weak security impact.
PR 358 (hostname checks enabled by default) only changes a preferences XML default.
Valid default-file-access WebView hardenings (PRs 1542, 115, 271, 61); one representative (AirMapView) was used to avoid duplicates.
Issue 8143 (conversation visible in recents before the PIN) is still open and unfixed.
PR 3714 ('Security and trust issue reported by the playStore') only removes an unneeded location permission.

No clean app-level vulnerable/fixed pair was found for MASWE-0035 (WebView loading untrusted content from intents or deep links, outside already-used advisories), iOS MASWE-0034 (broad loadFileURL read access), MASWE-0036 (secure text entry) or Android MASWE-0026 (cleartext set up in code with a stated security rationale).
